The website calculator...'), value persisted in site_settings and reflected on reload; then restored to 55000; (f) Admin Products: created TEST_Product with PNG upload -> Supabase storage 'products' bucket returned public URL (jiorzvadpvnviampkels.supabase.co/storage/v1/object/public/products/<ts>-test_product.png), thumbnail rendered in admin table, product appeared on public /products with image and product-detail page loaded with spec table + correct wa.me link; (g) Admin Customers: added TEST_Portal customer with email, row showed 'Awaiting sign-up'; (h) Admin Projects: added TEST_Project linked to the newly created customer via dropdown (dropdown correctly listed the customer after a small mount-time wait) and marked Published; (i) Customer Portal RLS: in a fresh incognito context, signed up at /customer with the SAME email portaltest+<ts>@example.com -> portal activated automatically (customer-portal visible, portal-not-active not shown) and displayed exactly 1 project (the linked one) and 0 quotations - RLS ownership scoping is correctly enforced (did not leak other customers' rows).

issues: Customer dropdown is populated by a single useEffect that fires on mount only. If you click 'Add' immediately after switching from Customers -> Projects, the customers list may not have resolved yet and the dropdown shows only the '— not linked —' placeholder. Add a small loading state or refetch on drawer open.

critical_code_review_comments: Manage.jsx: customers list is fetched once on mount when needsCustomers=true. If admin navigates Customers -> Projects and hits Add immediately, the dropdown briefly shows no options. Consider re-fetching when the drawer opens, or await the load before rendering the customer <select>.
Manage.jsx handleUpload does not enforce max file size or MIME whitelist. Supabase Storage anon policy accepts any file - large image uploads should be guarded client-side.
SettingsPage.jsx does not validate ranges (e.g. savings_factor must be 0-1; subsidies non-negative). A stray value here silently propagates to the public calculator.

Customer.jsx sign-up creates an auth user; matching to customers.profile_id relies on the DB trigger. If a customer signs up with an email NOT pre-added by admin, they permanently see portal-not-active. Consider surfacing 'Contact us' guidance or a self-serve request flow (WhatsApp CTA is present, good).

ProductDetail.jsx does not filter by is_published, so unpublished product IDs can still be viewed directly if the id is known (minor; RLS may block for anon depending on policy - verify Supabase RLS on products SELECT).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the requested new-feature flows passed

context_for_next_testing_agent: Migration 003 is live: storage buckets 'products'/'projects', customers table with profile_id auto-linked via email trigger on auth signup, site_settings public read/admin write. RLS ownership on quotations/projects/service_requests via customer_id -> customers.profile_id = auth.uid() is confirmed working. When testing customer portal, MUST use a fresh browser context - if admin is logged in in the same context, /customer takes them to their own (empty) portal instead of the sign-up form. Also give Manage.jsx ~2s to fetch customers before opening the Projects/Services drawer, otherwise the customer dropdown is empty.
rca of the issue: No blocking bugs. One minor UX quirk in Manage.jsx: customer dropdown may briefly show only the placeholder if the drawer is opened before the customers listRows() promise resolves. Reproduction: log in as admin, navigate Customers -> Add customer -> immediately click Projects -> Add. Mitigation: refetch customers inside the drawer effect, or gate the <select> render on a customers-loaded flag.
